title: Witch in Haunted Hallway
description: A sinister witch with a skeletal face stands in a derelict hallway, holding a glowing skull staff. The decaying walls are covered in grotesque screaming faces and bloody paintings while papers and debris litter the wooden floor under a single hanging lightbulb.
prompt: A skeletal-faced witch wearing a pointed hat and tattered green robes stands in a long decaying hallway, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing purple skull. The walls are covered in painted screaming faces and bloody dripping artwork, one large swirling painting and one lightning painting lean against the wall, papers and broken objects cover the wooden floor, single hanging lightbulb casts sickly yellow light, eerie horror atmosphere, dark fantasy style
